subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Siva is a hard worker. He works __________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**hard**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**hard**" is used to describe the manner in which someone works, meaning with great effort or diligence. (कड़ी मेहनत)
 
• In this context, "hard" directly describes how Siva works, meaning he works with great effort or intensity.
 
• The other options: "**bad**," "**scarcely**," and "**hardly**" do not fit the context. "Bad" would imply poor performance, while "scarcely" and "hardly" indicate a lack of effort, which contradicts the meaning of the sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Siva is a hard worker. He works hard__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Bad (खराब)**: refers to something of poor quality or performance, which does not fit the sentence context about hard work.
 
• **Scarcely (मुष्किल से)**: means rarely or barely, which suggests limited effort and does not align with the idea of hard work.
 
• **Hardly (बमुश्किल)**: means barely or almost not at all, which contradicts the meaning of working hard.
